value.rationale: The two solutions are canonical refinements of the same covering relation, distinguished by repeated elimination versus stability. The first disparity layer is therefore a mathematically motivated boundary. The complete classification is structurally informative: iteration does nothing, stability removes exactly one three-cycle, and only one unlabeled obstruction exists.
